scene: Her photo, in the AI Visualizer
try: Open Sophia’s site photo in the AI Visualizer
how:
1. Open Sophia Wong › "Files", open the Site photos folder and double-click sophia-living-room.jpg
2. Click "More options" (⋮, top right), then "Open in AI Visualizer"
3. Read the tip, press "Got it"; look at the squares on the photo
4. Click the eye icon ("Hide markers"), then again ("Show markers")
expect: Full screen: "Sophia Wong", chip "LEAD · WON", a room named "Living room" from the file; squares on walls and floor; "Marked roughly on your photo — …".
in10: New in 2.0

scene: Her photo, in the AI Visualizer
try: Check the room’s menu and mark the lamp it missed
how:
1. Click the ⋯ inside the room's chip ("Room options"), read the menu, press Esc
2. Open "Furniture", press "Add furniture": "Piece" Floor lamp, then the chip "Lighting"
3. Press "Click where it is", then click the lamp’s yellow shade on the photo
4. On the "Floor Lamp" row press ✕ ("Take off the list …"), then "Undo" in the message
expect: The menu offers "Rename", "Change photo", "Delete room"; "Floor Lamp" joins the furniture list; Undo restores it after "… taken off the list".
in10: Different from 1.0: taking a mark off has Undo

try: Pick a sage paint for the walls and a walnut floor
how:
1. Open "Surfaces", click the "Walls" row (or the square on a wall) — it starts on "As in the photo"
2. Search sage and click "Sage Green"
3. Press "All surfaces", click "Floor", chip "Flooring" › "Walnut Engineered"
4. Read the foot of the panel
expect: The picked wall lights up on the photo; "Recent" holds Sage Green; the foot lists both changes; the button reads "Generate · 2 changes" with its price, 10, on its chip.
in10: Different from 1.0: the picked surface lights up on the photo

try: Generate, stop one midway, then compare before and after
how:
1. Beside "Makes 1 version · Fast" press "Change", pick Quality "High", press "Done"
2. Press "Generate · 2 changes", then "Cancel" on the card at once
3. Press "Generate · 2 changes" again and wait
4. Press "Compare" under the photo and drag the line across
expect: "Stopped — nothing was kept or charged"; then "Reading the photo"…, "V1 is ready", a "V1 · Walls, Floor" tile, and a slider "Original" | "V1".
in10: Different from 1.0: compare right on the photo, one press

try: Describe a change in your own words
how:
1. In "DESCRIBE A CHANGE" type make it nice and read the line under the button
2. Replace the words with warmer evening light, press "Generate from note"
expect: First "Generate from note" stays greyed: "We couldn’t turn that note into a change — …"; then "V2 · From a note": evening light, walls still sage.
in10: Different from 1.0: the words box is always in view

scene: The whole look on a sample room
try: Add the sample living room to her design
how:
1. Press "Add room" in the top bar
2. Read the ways in
3. Under "SAMPLE ROOMS" click "Living room" ("Furnished photo")
4. Open "Furniture"
expect: The upload box ("Drop room photos or browse" · "JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC · …"), "FROM SOPHIA WONG’S FILES", "SAMPLE ROOMS"; a "Living room 2" chip opens, its 10 pieces listed.
in10: Different from 1.0: sample rooms and the lead’s files too

scene: The whole look on a sample room
try: Recolour the sofa, swap the table, take out the TV
how:
1. "Grey Fabric Sofa" › "Customize" › "Velvet", then under "COLOUR" "Emerald"
2. "Oak Coffee Table" › "Replace", pick any "Quick pick"
3. "Wall-Mounted TV" › "Remove"; press ⌘Z (Ctrl+Z), then ⇧⌘Z (Ctrl+Shift+Z)
4. Press "Generate · 3 changes"
expect: Rows read "Customize · Emerald velvet", "Replace · …", "Taken out"; ⌘Z/⇧⌘Z flip the TV; "V1 is ready": green sofa, new table, no TV.
in10: Different from 1.0: ⌘Z takes back a pick

scene: The whole look on a sample room
try: Restyle the room, then try a light live
how:
1. Open "Style", click "Japandi", read the line under the title, press "Restyle as Japandi"
2. Open "Lighting", click "Golden Hour"
3. Open "Fine-tune it by hand", drag "Colour temperature"
4. Press "Relight"
expect: A line warns "A style restyles the whole room from the photo — …"; "V2 is ready" ("V2 · Japandi"); Style is back on "None"; the light previews live; "V3 · Relit · Custom" lands.
in10: Different from 1.0: light previews live, kept in one step

scene: The whole look on a sample room
try: Hang a patterned wallpaper, two takes at once
how:
1. Under "VERSIONS" click "Original"
2. "Surfaces": click a wall square, keep "All walls · 2"
3. Chip "Wallpapers" › "Tropical Botanical"
4. "Change" › "Versions" 2, press "Generate"
expect: The swatch wears a leaf pattern; "V4–V5 are ready" — two takes from one press: V4’s two walls in the leaf paper, V5 tries another paper.
in10: Different from 1.0: 2–3 versions on a desktop too

scene: The whole look on a sample room
try: Empty the room, then furnish it again
how:
1. Click "V4", open "Tools", pick "Empty the room", then "Keep built-ins"
2. Press "Empty the room"
3. In "Tools" pick "Furnish the room", read "Will place:"
4. Press "Furnish the room"
expect: A version "Emptied · Keep built-ins" shows the room bare; then a "Furnished" version puts furniture back.
in10: Same as 1.0

scene: The whole look on a sample room
try: Borrow a look from a photo
how:
1. Click "Original", open "Style"
2. Under "OR BORROW A LOOK FROM A PHOTO" press "Upload a reference photo", pick kitchen-moodboard.jpg
3. Read "HOW FAR" and "WHAT CARRIES OVER"; beside "Makes 2 versions · Fast" press "Change", pick "Versions" 1, press "Done"
4. Press "Style transfer"
expect: The reference shows with its colours under it; "V8 is ready": a "V8 · Style transfer" version wears the photo’s colours.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Delete a version, undo it, and restore it later
how:
1. On "V5" open ⋮ ("More options for V5") › "Delete", then "Undo"
2. Delete V5 again, then reload the page
3. Beside "VERSIONS" click "1 deleted", press "Restore"
expect: "V5 deleted" with Undo; after the reload every room, version and the "Saved …" stamp are as you left them; Restore brings V5 back ("V5 restored").
in10: Different from 1.0: Undo, a Deleted list, nothing lost on reload

try: Pin a note on a version and resolve it
how:
1. Click the "Living room" chip, then the "V1" tile
2. Press the pin icon ("Pin a note"), click a wall
3. Write Sage on this wall only?, press "Pin it"
4. Write a reply, press "Reply", then the tick ("Resolve")
expect: Pin 1 sits on the photo (the box said "Only your team sees it"); its card shows your note and reply, then "Resolved".
in10: Different from 1.0: pins on any version, not only portal shares

try: Present a version, open its moodboard, download it
how:
1. Press "Present" (full-screen icon under the photo); press "Next version", then "Before and after · V1"; "Done"
2. On V1 open ⋮ › "Moodboard", read it, press "Done"
3. On V1 open ⋮ › "Download"
expect: A large view lists "WHAT CHANGED"; the moodboard shows "FINISHES" and "THE COLOURS IT READS AS"; "Render - Living room - V1.jpg" downloads.
in10: Different from 1.0: Present and a moodboard replace the view

try: Save a render to her Files and come back to it
how:
1. On V1 open ⋮ › "Save to Files"
2. Press "Open" in the message
3. Click "Information" (ⓘ) and read "From"
4. Open "More options" (⋮) › "Open this version in AI Visualizer"
expect: "V1 saved to Files › Renders"; "Render - Living room - V1.jpg" reads From "AI Visualizer · Living room · V1"; its menu reopens V1.
in10: Different from 1.0: 1.0 promised this, never saved

try: Turn a version’s finishes into quote lines
how:
1. On V1 open ⋮ › "Add to a quote…"
2. Read "THE LINES"; under "INTO" "A new quote" is already picked
3. Press "Add to quote", then "Open" in the message
4. Close the quote (✕) to come back
expect: Two lines, each "In at S$0 — yours to price" ("0 OF 2 PRICED"); "2 lines added"; the quote holds a section "Living room · V1 finishes".
in10: New in 2.0

try: Share two versions with Sophia
how:
1. Press "Share with client" (top right)
2. Under "LIVING ROOM" V1 is already ticked — tick V2 too; write a line in "A note on the page (optional)"
3. Press "Create link", then "Copy link"
4. Press "Open WhatsApp" — a WhatsApp tab opens: close it, do not send
expect: Shared versions also go to Files › Renders; "Link copied"; the draft starts "Hi Sophia, here are 2 design ideas for your living room".
in10: Different from 1.0: pick up to six; WhatsApp, no chat

try: Open the link as Sophia and compare
how:
1. Open a private window and paste the link
2. Read the page
3. On "Design 1" press "Before and after" and drag the line
expect: The studio’s letterhead, "FOR SOPHIA", "2 design ideas for your living room", your note; each design lists what changed; the slider shows "Before" and "After".
in10: Different from 1.0: several designs on one branded page

try: Pick a favourite, leave a note, pin a change
how:
1. On "Design 1" press "I like this one"
2. "Leave a note": write Could the floor be a shade lighter?, press "Send"
3. "Pin a note", click the sofa, write Keep this sofa?, press "Pin it"
expect: "Your favourite" and "Thanks — Dane will see it’s your favourite"; "Sent — Dane will see it"; "Pinned — Dane will see it".
in10: Different from 1.0: the client answers on the link

try: Ask the studio to call you back
how:
1. Scroll to "Want to talk it through?"
2. Leave the number box empty; in "Anything to mention? (optional)" write Evenings are best
3. Press "Ask for a call back"
expect: It said "Dane will call you back on the number they have for you."; now it reads "Dane will call you back".
in10: Different from 1.0: the request becomes a task

try: See Sophia’s answers reach Sarah, who owns her
how:
1. Leave the design with the back arrow; "Demo Studio" block › "View as" › "Sarah"
2. Click "Notifications" (the bell), then "Sophia Wong pinned a note on a render"
3. Press the back arrow and open the "Tasks" tab
expect: Four entries from Sophia; the design opens on V1 with her pin open; Tasks lists "Call Sophia Wong back about the renders" for Sarah and Dane.
in10: New in 2.0

try: Check who may rename or delete a design
how:
1. Side navigation "Tools" › "AI Visualizer", open the "Showroom ideas" folder
2. Open ⋮ on "Showroom — kitchen concept"
3. Close it; "Demo Studio" block › "View as" › "Dane"
expect: "Move to Folder", "Rename" and "Delete" are greyed: "Only Dane, an Owner or an Admin can move, rename or delete this".
in10: Different from 1.0: the maker’s rule, not an admin-only page

try: Read the design’s trail on Sophia’s lead
how:
1. Open Sophia Wong › "Activity"
2. Read today’s AI Visualizer lines
3. On "Overview" press the quick link "AI Visualizer", then the back arrow
expect: Lines "You rendered V1 of “Living room” — Walls, Floor." and "Sophia Wong asked for a call back about the renders."; the link opens it.
in10: New in 2.0

try: Stop sharing the link, then renew it
how:
1. Open her design again (the "AI Visualizer" quick link), press "Share with client" and read "SHARED BEFORE"
2. On the link’s row press the broken-link icon ("Stop sharing"), then "Stop sharing" in the question
3. Reload the private window
4. Close it (✕), press "Share with client" again, then "Renew" on the row; reload the private window again
expect: The row lists the opening, favourite, note and call back; then it reads "Stopped" and Sophia sees "This link is no longer active"; after "Renew" her page is back.
in10: Different from 1.0: links can be stopped and renewed

try: Find your way round the AI Visualizer page
how:
1. Side navigation "Tools" › "AI Visualizer"; read the intro and the cards
2. Open "New" and read its three ways in; press Esc
3. Click "Kind: All" › "Personal", then back to "All"
4. Type kitchen in the search box
expect: Sophia Wong reads "Lead · Won · 2 rooms · …"; cards say when last "edited"; searching leaves Kevin Ng and "Showroom — kitchen concept".
in10: Different from 1.0: a Kind pill instead of view chips

try: Start a design in a folder and render a sketch
how:
1. Clear the search, open the "Showroom ideas" folder, "New" › "Blank design"
2. Under "Add the first room" › "SAMPLE ROOMS" click "Kitchen sketch"
3. Press "Render from sketch" and wait
4. Press the back arrow
expect: An empty design opens with the chip "PERSONAL"; "This photo reads as a sketch. …"; "V1 · From sketch" is a kitchen photo; the folder holds your design.
in10: Different from 1.0: sketch to photo at every width

try: Duplicate a design, delete the copy, find it again
how:
1. On your new design’s card open ⋮ › "Duplicate"
2. On the copy open ⋮ › "Delete", press "Delete", then "Undo"
3. Tick the copy’s box, press "Delete" in the bar and confirm
4. Open "More options" (⋮, top right) › "Deleted Designs"
expect: "Duplicated as a personal copy"; Undo brings the copy back ("… restored"); the bar offers "Move to Folder"; Deleted Designs lists the copy.
in10: Different from 1.0: delete has Undo and a Deleted list

try: Add the fluted panel to the studio’s materials
how:
1. Side navigation "Company" › "Materials", then "New" › "New material"
2. Press "Upload a photo", pick fluted-panel.jpg
3. "Name" (replace what is there) Fluted feature wall panel · "Category" Laminates · "Finish" Textured · "Price book item" Fluted feature wall panel
4. Press "Add material"
expect: "Material added"; its card shows the photo, "Laminates · Textured" and "Quoted as Fluted feature wall panel".
in10: Different from 1.0: a Company page, linked to the Price book

try: Try a sample swatch in this design only
how:
1. "Tools" › "AI Visualizer" › "Sophia Wong"; click the "Living room" chip, then "Walls"
2. Press "Upload a swatch" and pick fluted-panel.jpg
3. In "Add a material" turn off "Save to the studio’s materials", press "Use in this design"
expect: The dialog shows the photo and "Renders as #…"; the change reads "Walls → fluted panel"; "YOUR STUDIO" lists it for this design.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Use the studio’s material and see it priced
how:
1. In the same picker search Fluted; click "Fluted feature wall panel" under "YOUR STUDIO"
2. Press "Generate"
3. On the new version open ⋮ › "Add to a quote…", read the lines, press "Cancel"
expect: The change reads "Walls → Fluted feature wall panel"; in the quote dialog that line says "Priced from the Price book" ("1 OF 2 PRICED").
in10: New in 2.0

try: See what Kevin Ng’s client already said
how:
1. Back on the AI Visualizer page open "Kevin Ng", click the "Living room" chip
2. Click the version tile with the star, then the blue pin on the photo
3. Open "Style"; then "Surfaces" › "Walls"
expect: A starred favourite; his pin "Is the velvet easy to keep clean? We have a dog." has Dane’s reply; "Kevin’s style: Contemporary — Modern is the nearest …"; "SUGGESTED · MODERN".
in10: New in 2.0

try: Change a finish on the phone
how:
1. On the phone (the "Network" address, as in chapter 12): bottom bar "Tools" › "AI Visualizer" › "Sophia Wong"
2. Tap "Surfaces" in the dock, tap "Walls", tap any paint (e.g. "Warm Greige")
3. Tap "Generate" above the dock
4. Tap "Tools" in the dock and look
expect: Room chips, photo, "VERSIONS", a five-mode dock; the panel rises; the bar counts "1 change"; a version lands; "Furnish the room" is greyed, saying why.
in10: Different from 1.0: every tool on a phone, furnish too

try: Open Sophia’s link on the phone and compare
how:
1. In the design tap "Share with client" (the send icon)
2. Under "SHARED BEFORE" tap "Open the link" (↗)
3. On "Design 1" tap "Before and after" and drag the line with a finger
expect: Sophia’s page fits the phone; the line follows your finger; "Your favourite" still marks Design 1.
in10: Same as 1.0
